smiṃ: [ sa် + ma် + i=smi + -ṃ=smiṃ. sa=ha. ha် + ma် + i=hmi=mhi. ]  CL=9 smiṃ- vibhatti. 13th vibhatti of the 14 vibhattis (nominal case-endings). Si yo aṃ yo nā hi sanaṃ smā hi sanaṃ smiṃ su. Kaccāyana, sutta. 55. Tato smiṃ ni. Kaccāya a, sutta. 212. (1) in- at =bhummattha. Gambhīre odakantike. (2) with- by =karaṇattha. Patte piṇḍāya gocare sampaṭicchāmi matthake. (3) paṭhamattha (nominative meaning). Sūriye uggate. (4)  to =sampadānattha. Saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. (5) while =anādarattha. Rudantasmiṃ dārake pabbaji. (6) of =niddhāraṇattha. Adhipatipaccaye sahajātādhipati nāma dhammekadeso. (7) when =bhāvena-bhāvalakkhaṇattha. Pāsāṇā sakkharā ceva, kaṭhalā khāṇukṭakā. Sabbe maggā vivajjenti, gacchante lokanāyake. (8) due to- because of =nimittattha. Sampajānamusāvāde pācittiyaṃ. (9) kammattha (accusative meaning). Muddhani cumbitvā. (1) in- at=bhummattha. (2) with- by=karaṇattha. (3) paṭhamattha (nominative meaning). (4) to =sampadānattha. (5) while=anādarattha. Gambhīre odakantike, abhivādenti bhikkhūsu. Dantesu haññeta nāgo. Patte piṇḍāya gocare. Sūriye uggate gaje. Rakkhantu kadalīsu ca. Mahapphalaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ. Rudantasmiṃ ca dārake. Vibhatyattha. 34-5. Gāthā. Hatthesu piṇḍāya caranti. Rū. 324. (6) of =niddhāraṇattha. “Adhipati-paccaye sahajātādhipati nāma, dhamme-kadeso”ti idaṃ ekavacanantaṃ sattamī-niddhāraṇaṃ. Nīti, sutta. 632. (7) when = bhāvenabhāvalakkhaṇattha. Pāsāṇā sakkharā ceva, kaṭhalā khāṇukṭakā. Sabbe maggā vivejjanti, gacchante lokanāyake. Rū. 327. (8) due to- because of=nimittattha. Sampajānamusāvāde pācittiyaṃ. Vi, 2. 2. (9) kammattha (accusative meaning). Muddhani cumbitvā. Rū. 324. in Vibhatyattha, there are 14 meanings of sattamīvibhatti (smiṃ, su). Here, there is no mention of the example of su vibhatti, but there is the mention of nine meanings of smiṃ vibhatti having combined the common meanings.
smiṃvacana: [ smiṃ + vacana ]  CL=9 Smiṃ vibhatti. Smiṃvacanassa ni hoti. Kaccāyana, sutta. 212. Rū. 128.
smā: [ sa် + ma် + ā=smā. sa်=ha်. ha် + ā= hmā=mhā. ]  CL=9 Smā- vibhatti. 9th vibhatti of the 14 Nāma vibhattis (nominal case-ending) Si yo aṃ yo nā hi sa naṃ smā hi sanaṃ smiṃ su. Kaccayana, sutta. 55. Smā nā. Kaccāyana, sutta. 214.  (1) from = ablative meaning. Pāpācittaṃ nivāraye. (2) in-at = locative meaning. yasmā khemaṃ. (3) of = genitive meaning. purisasmā pādā phaliṃ. (4) accusative meaning. suvaṇṇasmā pati dadā.  (5) due to- because of= hetvattha- the meaning of the cause. kasmā hetu na miyyanti. (6) with- by = tatiyattha (instrumental meaning). satasmā bandho naro. (7) for = dative meaning. kasmā vattabbaṃ. (8) below- less than = vibhattyattha (comparative meaning). na tato ūnādhikānīti attho. (9) more than = vibhattyattha (comparative meaning). Sīlameva sutā seyyo na tato ūnādhikā-nīti attho.  (1) from =apādānattha. (2) in- at =sattamyattha. (3) of =sambandhattha. (4) kammattha. (5) due to- because of=hetvattha. Kasmā hetu na miyyanti. (6) with- by =tatiyattha. Pāpācittaṃ nivāraye. Yasmā khemaṃ tato bhayaṃ. Purisasmā pādā phaliṃ. Suvaṇṇasmā pati dadāma. Kasmā hetu na miyyanti. Satasmā bandho naro. Vibhatyattha. 25-6. Gāthā. (7) for =sampadānattha. ----kasmā vattabbaṃ----. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 159. (8) below- less than = vibhatyattha. ---- na tato ūnādhikānīti attho. Maṇimañjū, 1. 184. (9) more than = vibhatyattha. Sīlameva sutā seyyo. Rū. 162. Na tato ūnādhikānīti attho. Maṇimañjū, 1. 184. "to" suffix can also be used in place of smā- vibhatti.
smāvacana: [ smā + vacana ]  CL=9 Smā vibhatti. Smāvacanassa nā hoti. Kaccāyana, sutta. 214. Rū. 128.
